author: Will_29
body: You can absolutely start getting ascension levels now. Keep in mind that they are tied to your class, so if you decide later to main another class you'll have wasted the resources (you can get some back, but it is only a partial refund).

author: Apprehensive-Nose646
body: If you are going to stick with the summoner classes then go ahead and start doing ALs, if you aren't sure yet then wait.
